title: Pair-level audit of the current replay of the original non-ML mathematics unbuilt scan
scope: Current local root-math plan and working tree; non-ML A/B pairs only. Machine learning and the separate physics build are excluded. Publication means explicit local frontmatter status; this is not a deployed VPS inventory.

provenance.exact_historical_membership_caveat: The original scan saved category aggregates but not row IDs. This audit uses a replay of the recovered exact classifier against the current worktree; the replay matches all 31 category totals and total 367 but cannot guarantee immutable historical row membership.

classifier_summary.original_scan_rule: Both A/B page sources had to exist, their frontmatter page IDs had to match, and each post-frontmatter body had to be at least 30 characters. Effective inventories used planned item IDs when nonempty, otherwise actual page items+examples; each inventory had to be nonempty; every planned ID had to appear in that page inventory; extra actual IDs were allowed. Every planned/actual item carrier needed a non-placeholder post-frontmatter body of at least 20 characters; counterexample/false-statement items with proof:not-supplied failed. Status was ignored and no proof-correctness audit was run.
classifier_summary.reclassification_rule: Substantive pair-specific exposition, proofs, worked examples and item carriers establish built content. A blank B summary is not a content gap when its actual inventory contains substantive item carriers. A substantive B worked-example paragraph can establish content even if its item inventory is empty. A page-inventory ID mismatch alone is not missing authoring when the item source exists. Current plan IDs with no source are recorded as undrafted unless explicitly stale; proof:not-supplied remains unfinished work. Publication bins use explicit local status and treat absent pages/items/unfinished obligations as partial pair publication.
classifier_summary.reused_suppliers: Reused supplier items alone were not treated as authoring for the new pair; pair-specific page/item sources were evaluated.
